body: In collaboration with eDC, a month-long DeepTech entrepreneurship program with 220+ registrations and 62 teams, resulting in 12 functional MVPs and 10 final pitches to industry judges. Five teams sought further support, highlighting ARIES' strong role in nurturing hands-on innovation and startup culture on campus.
title: Ship-A-Thon: DeepTech
description: Month-long entrepreneurship program with eDC — 12 MVPs, 10 final pitches.
